headline: This resolution reappoints Steve Case to another term as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
what_it_does: The Smithsonian Institution is run by a Board of Regents that includes citizen members chosen outside the government. This joint resolution gives Steve Case a new term as one of those citizen regents. The official summary does not describe any other changes to the Smithsonian or its rules.

who_it_affects.how: He continues serving as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian's Board of Regents for another term.

when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate effective date; it was enacted on April 19, 2017.
